objective: Reduce exact Boolean matrix-F4 solver work by computing only decisive linear consequences and avoiding redundant lower-degree passes on wide public-synthetic Koblitz systems.

selected_policy.degree_schedule: build only the configured maximum degree, whose row space contains every lower-degree row
selected_policy.elimination: forward echelon through degree-at-least-2 columns, then full RREF on the degree-at-most-1 tail
selected_policy.readback: materialize only constant-one or single-variable consequences

controls.KIC_F4_MAX_DEGREE_ONLY: 0 restores the degree ladder; 1 forces maximum-degree-only
controls.KIC_F4_SOLVER_LINEAR_TAIL: 0 restores full RREF; 1 forces linear-tail elimination

acceptance: same executable for selected and legacy paired arms
identical target count, verdict mix, effort, built degree, first-fall degree, and gates
exhaustive small-system root-set equivalence with the selected path forced
wall, child CPU, peak RSS, phase timing, F4 calls, and word XORs retained
claim_boundary: Public-synthetic n=31 decomposition-solver evidence only. This is not relation-yield evidence, an end-to-end index-calculus crossover, an asymptotic improvement, a sub-rho result, an external-target capability, or a key-recovery claim.
